stage1_evidence_shown.label: PURPOSE
stage1_evidence_shown.context: This study aims to evaluate local failure patterns in node negative breast cancer patients treated with post-mastectomy radiotherapy including internal mammary chain only.

stage1_evidence_shown.label: PATIENTS AND METHODS
stage1_evidence_shown.context: Retrospective analysis of 92 internal or central-breast node-negative tumours with mastectomy and external irradiation of the internal mammary chain at the dose of 50 Gy, from 1994 to 1998.

stage2_added_evidence.label: RESULTS
stage2_added_evidence.context: Local recurrence rate was 5 % (five cases). Recurrence sites were the operative scare and chest wall. Factors associated with increased risk of local failure were age<or = 40 years and tumour size greater than 20mm, without statistical significance.
